strategy.name: Remaining zone detectors - common failure test
strategy.description: Frozen initial screen of seven remaining level families and a previous-bar sweep benchmark under common trade mechanics.
strategy.migration_scope: NQ 15m, one contract. Nine detector candidates plus one generic prior-bar benchmark, 80-chart-bar lifetime, +/-0.10 formation ATR, completed-bar arming, first armed physical visit consumed even outside regular hours, close inside zone, next contiguous open, sweep stop and 20-bar exit. Regular-hour entries; positions can carry. HTF candles contain all expected observed 15m bars, which does not prove minute completeness. Strict two-left/two-right swings activate after confirmation. No matched location control, tick-order proof, roll adjustment, extra event-entry delay, or untouched-holdout claim. Prior studies with different lifetimes/visits are descriptive comparisons only.

detector.description: Prespecified detector; all use the identical failure-test trade engine.

zone_half_width_atr.description: Zone half-width frozen from completed formation ATR(14).

swing_sides.description: Frozen two-left/two-right swing confirmation; also declares conservative HTF warmup.
